newsitem.title: UK: Scotia shares fall amid caution over drugs.
newsitem.headline: Scotia shares fall amid caution over drugs.

text.p: Shares in Britain's second-biggest biotech group, Scotia Holdings Plc, slipped to their lowest levels for five months in late morning trading on Wednesday amid concerns over progress on key drugs.
Shares in Scotia were down 29 pence to 657 by 1041 GMT after touching a session low of 640 pence.
Analysts said delays in the timetable for approvals of its diabetic drug Tarabetic and in proving the efficacy of anti- cancer drug EF13 are depressing sentiment.
Scotia announced interim results and a research and development update on Tuesday.
